metadata.note: Simplified rule set — only generic, automatable rules retained

rules.title: Package to bear prescribed information
rules.requirement: Every pre-packaged commodity shall bear on its package, or on a label securely affixed thereto, the following declarations, namely: (a) name, address and country of origin of the manufacturer or importer; (b) name of the commodity; (c) net quantity; (d) unit sale price; (e) retail sale price; (f) date of manufacturing or pre-packing; (g) best before or use by date; (h) batch number; (i) consumer care contact details
rules.limitations: Cannot verify if all legally required declarations are present if OCR fails to detect text

rules.title: Manufacturer/packer/importer details
rules.requirement: The name and complete address of the manufacturer or packer or importer, as the case may be, shall be declared on the package in a clear and legible manner.
rules.limitations: Address completeness cannot be fully verified from OCR alone

rules.title: Name of commodity
rules.requirement: The name of the commodity shall be printed or written on the package or on a label affixed thereto in a clear, concise, and intelligible manner.

rules.title: Mandatory declarations on principal display panel
rules.requirement: The following declarations shall be made on the principal display panel: (a) the name of the commodity; (b) the net quantity; (c) the unit sale price; (d) the retail sale price; (e) the date of manufacture or pre-packing; (f) the best before or use by date, wherever applicable; (g) the batch number; (h) the name and address of the manufacturer; (i) the consumer care contact details.
rules.limitations: Consumer care contact may be present but not detected by OCR

rules.title: Consumer care contact details
rules.requirement: The consumer care contact details, including at least one of: telephone number, email address, or website, shall be declared on the package.
rules.limitations: Contact details may be present but in small text not detected by OCR

rules.title: Net quantity in SI units
rules.requirement: The net quantity of the commodity shall be declared in terms of weight (kilogram or gram), measure (litre, millilitre), or number (count) as appropriate. Units shall follow the International System of Units (SI).
rules.limitations: Cannot verify actual quantity matches declared quantity

rules.title: Standard quantities for pre-packaged commodities
rules.requirement: Pre-packaged commodities shall be sold only in standard quantities as specified in the First Schedule of the rules. Non-standard quantities require specific approval.
rules.limitations: Standard quantity lists may not cover all products

rules.title: Unit sale price
rules.requirement: The unit sale price shall be declared in terms of per unit, per kilogram, per litre, or per number, as the case may be.
rules.limitations: Unit price may not be present on all packages

rules.title: Date of manufacture or pre-packing
rules.requirement: The date of manufacture or pre-packing shall be declared in the format DD/MM/YYYY or DD-MM-YYYY or Month Year. Best before or use by date shall also be declared where applicable.
rules.limitations: Date format recognition varies. Some dates may be in regional formats.
